patthana19.3:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, na vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāka dhammadhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, pañca.
patthana19.3:2.1: na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā. na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipāka na vipāka dhammadhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana19.3:3.1: na nevavipāka na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nevavipāka na vipāka dhammadhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā. na nevavipāka na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca vipāko dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, pañca.
